description: Aider-polyglot style (Java): fewest coins for an amount with arbitrary denominations from a stub and an instructions file - greedy fails on some sets, ties between equally short answers resolved to the lexicographically smallest ascending list, exact error messages in a fixed order (negative amount, non-positive denomination, impossible amount), unsorted/duplicated/unmodifiable inputs, and a 100k amount that needs a real dynamic program. A protected run_tests.py compiles with javac and runs the plain-Java test runner; the post-turn verifier gives a failing first attempt a repair round, like aider's second try.
